# graylog_content_pack_installation (Resource)

Manages a Graylog content pack installation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "graylog_content_pack_installation" "example" {
  content_pack_id = "90be5e03-cb16-c802-6462-a244b4a342f3"
  revision        = 1
  comment         = "Installed by Terraform"
  parameters_json = jsonencode({})
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content_pack_id` (String)
- `revision` (Number)

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Optional installation comment.
- `parameters_json` (String) JSON object with content pack installation parameters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Installation ID returned by Graylog.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import graylog_content_pack_installation.example 90be5e03-cb16-c802-6462-a244b4a342f3/69babedb10ce598257cccd71
```
